limitations_and_boundaries: The paper discusses limitations in the last section (as stated in the checklist).

research_questions.statement: Can derivative information be leveraged to enhance the accuracy of DeepONet for parametric PDEs, especially with limited training data?

provenance.text_excerpt: Numerical experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach.

claims.statement: Numerical experiments validate the effectiveness of DE-DeepONet.

provenance.text_excerpt: We further demonstrate that the use of derivative loss can be extended to enhance other neural operators, such as the Fourier neural operator (FNO).

claims.statement: Derivative loss can be extended to enhance other neural operators, such as FNO.

provenance.text_excerpt: In this work we propose a derivative-enhanced deep operator network (DE-DeepONet), which leverages derivative information to enhance the solution prediction accuracy and provides a more accurate approximation of solution-to-parameter derivatives, especially when training data are limited.

claims.statement: DE-DeepONet improves solution prediction accuracy and provides more accurate approximation of solution-to-parameter derivatives compared to standard DeepONet, especially with limited training data.

experiments_or_tasks: Compare DE-DeepONet against DeepONet, FNO, and DINO on parametric PDE benchmarks.
Extend derivative loss to FNO and compare its performance.
Propose derivative-enhanced DeepONet (DE-DeepONet) with derivative-based dimension reduction and derivative loss.

methods.name: DE-DeepONet
methods.protocol_description: DE-DeepONet incorporates linear dimension reduction of high-dimensional parameter input into DeepONet and adds a derivative loss term in the loss function to leverage derivative information, reducing required parameter-solution pairs.

methods.name: DeepONet
methods.protocol_description: Standard deep operator network as a baseline.

methods.name: FNO
methods.protocol_description: Fourier neural operator as a baseline; also extended with derivative loss.

methods.name: DINO
methods.protocol_description: Derivative-informed neural operator as a baseline.

study_units.name: DE-DeepONet development and evaluation
